items.stem: How do risk appetite and risk tolerance differ?

options.text: Appetite is the broad level of risk an entity will accept; tolerance is the acceptable variation around a specific objective
options.rationale: Correct: appetite is strategic and broad; tolerance is the acceptable deviation for a given objective.
They are related but distinct concepts.

options.text: Tolerance is always higher than appetite
Appetite applies only to financial risk
